rows.implemented: DXF and SVG immutable sources become actual editable native sketch curves. DXF declared units and overrides are handled relative to the native reader's conversion; SVG physical dimensions use its native unit conversion.
rows.remaining: Calibrated raster reference imagery and text authoring are outside this panel. Large drawing text is subject to the native command payload limit.

rows.implemented: Named offset/angled/mid/three-point/tangent/path/perpendicular planes, axes and points use actual native reference features. Primary controls expose fields and nested reference editors, with additional native options available.
rows.measured: Changing an offset plane from 10 to 20 mm moves its dependent midplane sketch and trimmed/thickened solid from Z=5 to Z=10 while retaining 280 mm^3 solid volume.
rows.remaining: Not every geometric reference variant has a dedicated acceptance case; no general user-coordinate-system parity is claimed.

rows.implemented: Sixteen native surface operations are exposed with per-tool controls: patch, extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, offset, ruled, blend, trim, stitch, thicken, extend, untrim, unstitch, reverse normals and B-spline fairing.
rows.measured: A trimmed 7 by 20 mm patch thickens to a 280 mm^3 solid. Extruded rectangle walls and two caps stitch to one 600 mm^3 solid.
rows.remaining: Advanced loft/blend continuity combinations and nonlinear fairing require broader acceptance. Surface fillet is explicitly unavailable because the upstream handler is planned.

rows.implemented: Native trim/stitch and their companion repair operations persist in the canonical document. OCCT STEP diagnostics and tolerance-bounded ShapeFix healing produce an explicitly separate derived import, preserving the original source.
rows.remaining: Healing acceptance uses a valid manufactured fixture; this does not establish automatic repair of arbitrary corrupt CAD or missing geometry. Gap visualization and automatic repair suggestions are not implemented.

rows.implemented: The UI and capability query state the exact limitation and enable no fake Form operation.
rows.remaining: The pinned engine provides no persisted Form control-cage editing or general T-spline-to-B-rep command workflow. Low-level T-spline code and B-spline fairing are insufficient to claim this family.

rows.implemented: STL/OBJ native mesh bodies retain source provenance and explicit source units. Derived normalized sources retain the original bytes. Native bodies export as STL/OBJ; actual mesh-plane intersections export as unit-declared 3D DXF lines.
rows.measured: A 1 by 2 by 3 inch STL reopens with 25.4 by 50.8 by 76.2 mm bounds, survives OBJ re-import and undoes correctly.
rows.remaining: Section DXF is an exchange artifact, not an associative section-sketch feature. This upload adapter does not yet expose 3MF/glTF.

rows.implemented: Actual mesh diagnostics, duplicate/degenerate triangle cleanup, winding repair, triangle/quad hole filling, transforms, subdivision, vertex-clustering reduction, Laplacian smoothing, open plane cuts and native mechanical reconstruction are available. Diagnostics report boundaries, nonmanifold edges, winding, component count, bounds and volume only for valid volume meshes.
rows.measured: A missing triangle is repaired to a watertight 6000 mm^3 box. A closed box mesh reconstructs six editable planar faces and STEP export; an open mesh is rejected. Reduction reports measured vertex displacement and topology; cuts report their remaining open boundary.
rows.remaining: No general remeshing, self-intersection repair, arbitrary organic reconstruction, face-group editor, mesh Boolean or capped plane-cut parity. Clustering can change topology, smoothing can shrink shape, and each limitation is reported.

rows.implemented: STEP imports become editable native base bodies with immutable source hashes. Source B-rep diagnostics and derived healing preserve original file bytes and unit meaning.
rows.measured: A 6000 mm^3 imported STEP box accepts a 1 mm open-top native shell edit, yielding 1824 mm^3, while the immutable source remains 6000 mm^3.
rows.remaining: This adapter exposes STEP rather than every proprietary/native CAD translator. Corrupt topology families need additional fixtures.

rows.implemented: Current native STEP/STL/OBJ/native JSON and editable sketch DXF export to cache-scoped artifacts with byte counts and hashes. No project-controlled output path reaches the filesystem.
rows.remaining: Native JSON is not a complete portable archive for separately linked assets. Platform package export owns that workflow.

honesty: Bounded measured flows are implemented. These results do not establish complete Fusion parity for any entire workspace.
